dialogue:
Speaker1: Dambi looks super cute and is a total badass, plus she's smart.
Speaker2: Now it's a top predator; with three of them, they could take down a wild boar.
Speaker1: I hope you’re not serious with that, right?
Speaker2: They live in packs and hunt wild boars too.

Speaker1: Why do they say you 'got your head up' when you go to a golf course for the first time?
Speaker2: A lot of people think it's a technical term, but it's actually a sexist phrase.
Speaker1: I've heard more girls use it, though.
Speaker2: It's a prime example of how golf got established by some pretty lowbrow folks.

Speaker1: It's like telling someone with paralysis to exercise because they're weak.
Speaker2: Then just say what you want. If you’re just gonna complain, I got nothing to say. These days, MZs are pretty good at speaking up.
Speaker1: Don't judge me so easily, just be there for me.
Speaker2: Do you even know how hard it is to be around someone who's depressed for a long time?
Speaker1: Then just let me live like this alone.

Speaker1: Can people in their 20s and 30s really prepare for retirement and live a normal life?
Speaker2: I don't think so. Starting out in debt, then it's marriage and kids—it's all just giving up. It's kinda sad, really.
Speaker1: They're just draining us dry with unpaid internships, forcing us to pay more for health insurance 'cause we're young, and all that.

Speaker1: If those kids are the hope for Korea, then Korea's done for.
Speaker2: Can't even run a corner store, lol.
Speaker1: At this point, they seem addicted to self-sabotage, leaving a mess everywhere they go.
Speaker2: For real, that dude's the ultimate hypocrite who can't even tell right from wrong.

Speaker1: Is it normal for my mother-in-law to call me at dawn to make seaweed soup for my husband's birthday?
Speaker2: They say mothers-in-law are most scared of their daughters-in-law starving their sons. Gotta be worse on his birthday. Ugh, old ladies, smh.
Speaker1: I dragged myself outta bed to make seaweed soup for my husband, and then she called to check if I did.
Speaker2: Haha, mom's love for her son is next level.
Speaker1: I told her I fed him, and she still didn’t believe it. Like, come on, I’m losing it here. I kinda wanted to take back the seaweed soup I gave him.

Speaker1: Golf's pricey even up to PT, way more than gym stuff.
Speaker2: Is a random gym trainer the same as a pro golfer? It’s not like they just give you a quick look at the gym, right?
Speaker1: You haven't tried personal training, have you?
Speaker2: Can't believe you're comparing a pro golfer to a gym bro.

Speaker1: It's ironic that it's tough to live in Seoul without money, but you gotta come here 'cause you don't have any.
Speaker1: There's basically nowhere to live and make a living but Seoul.
Speaker2: The problem is most people just make excuses about the infrastructure while goofing off, even though living costs are double in Seoul.
Speaker1: Must be because there are just more jobs in Seoul, even if the pay's the same.

Speaker1: Ugh, meeting up with an old classmate today but it’s probably gonna be boring.
Speaker2: Don’t fake having the flu to bail.
Speaker1: Might as well just go out instead of hearing gossip for no reason.
Speaker2: Ain't that a waste of a precious weekend?
Speaker1: Since I gotta eat anyway, I might as well just go.

Speaker1: They gave me super thoughtful feedback on the comic I submitted to the Japanese magazine.
Speaker2: Ugh, in Korea they'd just be like "what is this trash?" and delete it right away, but Japan actually writes a long response.
Speaker1: Ugh, please be our master of the Korean Peninsula one more time; I’ll do better this time.
Speaker2: What the heck are those webtoon creators even doing? No knowledge, no feedback, not even checking for typos.

Speaker1: They say the older you get, the more you should open your wallet and close your mouth, right?
Speaker2: That's a classic saying, no matter the era haha.
Speaker1: These days, the MZ crowd says boomers can keep their wallets shut, but they should keep their mouths shut too, lol.
Speaker2: Lmao, I don't want money either, just stop with the nagging!
Speaker1: Honestly, that might be better for both of us, right? Just opening wallets is kinda stressful.
Speaker2: The problem is talking a big game but not paying up, lol.

Speaker1: Drinking alone again today. What’s life anyway? Just eat and enjoy while you can.
Speaker2: Ain't got a friend like booze. I'm done with backstabbers and two-faced people.
Speaker1: Best to just enjoy my solo drinks and eat whatever I want without seeing all that mess.
Speaker2: You could end up in a bad spot drinking alone. You're kinda pushing it, you know?
Speaker1: Who do you think you are, my wife? Talk like that and you’re out too.

Speaker1: Seriously curious what kind of life makes people idolize gamers like that.
Speaker2: It's kinda funny reading the comments from those insecure losers lol.
Speaker1: Those League of Legends guys are so gross, I looked them up and they’re super ugly, like how do they even draw like that? lol
Speaker2: Oh, he's so handsome! The best! lmao

Speaker1: If you’re thinking about war, getting a drone license is a no-brainer; drones have way better survival rates than infantry, that’s just common sense.
Speaker2: I feel you. With a drone license, I could just game my way through war... but without it, I’d be a bullet sponge, getting wrecked.
Speaker1: Just looking at the Ukraine war, it’s clear—infantry are getting wiped out by suicide drones.
Speaker2: Seems like everyone’s got a drone license now, so if a war breaks out, becoming a drone soldier might just be luck of the draw?

Speaker1: Where'd you get that info? lol I've lived in New York and never seen anyone care about socks, haha.
Speaker2: That YouTuber's just clueless lol, probably one of those cookie-cutter shorts creators spreading bad info.
Speaker1: The U.S. isn't full of bland, cookie-cutter people like Korea.
Speaker2: Guess they think everything's like Korea just 'cause that's all they see. Gotta filter out most of those shorts for real.

Speaker1: What a joke, right? Lmao.
Speaker2: Then why the hell did everyone resign? That makes no sense.
Speaker1: Live like trash with that mindset until the coffin's closed.
Speaker2: Guess it doesn't bother you working under a president who got wrecked in the National Assembly, huh? Must be your level, lol.

Speaker1: Whoa! That's wild! Totally got tricked.
Speaker2: These days, it all looks so real, it’s hard to tell.
Speaker1: I seriously can’t tell what’s real and what’s fake anymore.
Speaker2: It's easiest to just assume it's all fake.

Speaker1: I’m spending so much on in-game stuff as a newbie, can’t even eat or buy clothes, and now I’m super aware of my wife’s side-eye.
Speaker2: Yeah, that's true. Spending a ton on in-game stuff gets you through fast, but then they just drop new stuff to keep you in that endless loop. You used to give me a hard time about it, but look at you now lol.
Speaker1: I’ve dropped 130 in just two weeks. This game’s as addictive as drugs.
Speaker2: Just gotta wing it. Treat your main like an alt, and your alt like a side project, then you won't spend much. Don’t bother with item upgrades, just do some basic self-enchanting and call it a day.

Speaker1: If they check the test before going to the bathroom, then yeah, you gotta follow them in.
Speaker2: Nah, but there's such a thing as human rights, right? Is it normal supervision to watch someone pee with their pants down?
Speaker1: Isn’t it suspicious that a student here to take the test is acting like that? Shouldn’t they just hurry up and go back to the test instead of causing a scene?
Speaker2: Gotta follow the monitoring manual for cheating prevention, just to make sure who's responsible if something goes down.

Speaker1: What idiot thinks the minimum wage is 13,000 won? Show me the source.
Speaker2: It's funny how people whine about bread prices but drop 5 or 6 grand on coffee like it's nothing.
Speaker1: It's 10,030 won, you clueless idiot. Get a job at a convenience store or café... stop talking nonsense from your room.
Speaker2: Are you really not working? Aren't you getting your paid leave? Seriously, what's up with that? What about your severance pay? If they made the law, at least get what you're owed.

Speaker1: It's a simple fix—just cut down on bus stops and raise fares, but they're too scared of public opinion to do it.
Speaker2: That's called mindless marketism. Is life really that simple? Are you brain-dead?
Speaker1: Can’t just whine for subsidies when it doesn’t follow supply and demand.
Speaker2: Don’t you know Seoul’s public transport is all in the red and covered by taxes? Is it really that simple?

Speaker1: If you’ve only got 2,000 saved, that’s not really saving, just leftover cash.
Speaker2: So what's up with begging to buy a house then? Guess you can go for it without a loan.
Speaker1: No way you're over 35, right?
Speaker2: If you buy, it should be in your husband's name only, and you gotta get a notarized agreement saying it won't be split.

Speaker1: Yeah, the subway's packed at this hour.
Speaker2: Haha, for some reason there are way too many kids on Line 1 today.

Speaker1: When are we gonna stop hearing those idiots run their mouths? Just stay home and mind your business.
Speaker2: Feminists have totally wrecked the country lol, second-class citizens don’t even know their place.
Speaker1: For real, seeing feminists these days totally kills any thoughts of marriage... who’s gonna volunteer to be a "pungpung man"?
Speaker2: I’d rather just live single—way better to die alone than get drained by a feminist.

Speaker1: That's just a fancy way of saying they're begging for money from random people.
Speaker2: Begging's gotta get you something, right?
Speaker1: What kind of sales is that? The lady's just begging for attention with a loud voice.
Speaker2: If even one customer shows up from that, then it’s sales.

Speaker1: For real, I totally get how you could snap over noise complaints.
Speaker2: From experience, it’s usually the upstairs or sometimes the neighbors.
Speaker1: It's a messed up building design issue, so the sound can travel through the pillars and walls, could be from the neighbors or the unit below.
Speaker2: Honestly, it’s this chicken coop apartment culture, shoddy construction, and these builders just not giving a damn, lol.

Speaker1: What have we even done?
Speaker2: It's shocking how much more impressive China is than we are, honestly.
Speaker1: What can we do when two giant monsters are fighting? lol
Speaker2: This deep tech stuff kinda feels like a Sputnik shock, for real.

Speaker1: Whoa, I saw three girls with fake designer bags today. You could totally tell, I was blushing.
Speaker2: They really think no one can tell, huh? lol
Speaker1: Why go that far just to carry a designer bag?
Speaker2: They probably have their reasons, but I think rocking an eco bag is way cooler than carrying a fake.
Speaker1: I know I shouldn't be talking since I've never had a designer bag, but seriously, just leave the fakes at home!

Speaker1: Lol, in this hellish Korea, a senior singer gets wrecked if they don’t know a junior’s name.
Speaker2: This show's getting old. Why should someone who doesn't know feel sorry? Just work harder.
Speaker1: Forget everything else, just pick good songs. Even if you get the right kids, if the songs are trash, it ain't gonna fly.
Speaker2: Not a great look either. That kid's eyes and expression are a total turn-off.

Speaker1: Dude, did you see how much those mukbang YouTubers made? I almost quit out of jealousy.
Speaker2: Why the heck are people throwing money at those slobs slurping broth everywhere?
Speaker1: Haha, right? Watching those cellulite jiggles kinda kills the appetite, but the views are high.
Speaker2: I don’t get why people watch mukbangs, no idea what’s so interesting about it.

Speaker1: You know what "shop cop" means?
Speaker2: It's a Swedish term meaning "the shame of consumption." It's about not engaging in unnecessary consumption that harms the environment, like the environmental movements happening on social media.
Speaker1: It's a nice sentiment, but it kinda saves the environment and kills small businesses.

Speaker1: Why are those idiots freaking out about the guy wanting to light up on the balcony?
Speaker2: Don’t smoke inside, like in the bathroom or on the balcony.
Speaker1: It's my place, I'll smoke if I want, lol.
Speaker2: Yikes, not just burning cigs but their brain too, huh?

Speaker1: Why buy something that costs the same whether it’s made by a human or a robot?
Speaker2: Like, seriously, why's the price the same if a robot's cooking it?
Speaker1: Still pricey and small portions, huh.
Speaker2: Tried it, and dang, it’s just Han River ramen lol. Gotta smack that robot to get it to listen.

Speaker1: Isn't it super risky that a Thai singer got a full-body massage and ended up paralyzed?
Speaker2: Going back for more massages after that? Haha.
Speaker1: That's why you gotta get massages from a legit Chinese medicine doc.
Speaker2: They're all the same, whether it's acupuncturists or massage therapists, so what's the comparison?

Speaker1: Whoa, that pitcher’s got a real jerk vibe, not just missing the ball but straight up aiming for the head!
Speaker2: Love a good karma ending with a hit, haha, that bat flip was sick, lol.
Speaker1: They're really starting to show their true colors, one by one.
Speaker2: Those kinds of jerks should be banned for good, that's attempted murder.

Speaker1: Lmao, that person’s just spreading out like an octopus with a hundred arms, stalling indefinitely.
Speaker2: Everyone's just getting gaslit by that guy, he's just a frontman who talks a big game.
Speaker1: Gotta give him credit if he actually recovered the rocket boosters, lol.
Speaker2: What’s the point? His game-watching skills are worse than a random dog’s; did his judgment just vanish with his hair?

Speaker1: I thought I was gonna lose it because of my boss while trying to leave work.
Speaker2: So that's why you were late for your plans?
Speaker1: Totally forgot to mention, then he just tossed me some papers and said to look into it.
Speaker2: Yikes, what were you doing the whole shift then, right at quitting time?
Speaker1: I was so mad, felt like they were just messing with me on purpose.

Speaker1: She's pretty, but she's not even top tier in the West. Where's that 2nd place ranking from, some random source with no credibility?
Speaker2: Probably some random site with no credibility. No clue who’s 1st, but 2nd place is totally legit lol.
Speaker1: In Russia, you see faces like that everywhere, so it’s not even special. That’s why they’re kinda popular in Asian countries and end up living in Korea now.
Speaker2: For real, if she was really top tier, she'd be in the U.S., not stuck in Korea.

Speaker1: Why am I mad if I went to work to make money and they’re making me do stuff?
Speaker2: Gotta figure it out before they tell you. It's always the ones who can't do it that get mad when asked, lol.
Speaker1: Shut it, you’re the one handing out orders.

Speaker1: You're totally gonna mess up your life with that sleeping-in habit. Always late to work and stuff.
Speaker2: I’m not doing it on purpose. I hear the alarm and think I’ll just sleep for 5 more minutes, but it never works out.
Speaker1: If you can't fix that, even with your livelihood on the line, your mindset's seriously messed up.
Speaker2: If I’m late to work one more time, they said I gotta quit.
Speaker1: Guess you gotta get fired to wake up, tsk tsk.

Speaker1: Do guys start feeling pressure to get married in their mid-30s?
Speaker2: For sure, good women get snatched up fast.
Speaker1: Seems like there are a bunch of people around me stressing about it.
Speaker2: But for guys, as long as they’ve got money, it’s all good. Money-blinded girls will line up.

Speaker1: It's so obvious the girl's just after his money.
Speaker2: For real, with that face and money, he could totally get a hot girl. His taste in women is just terrible.
Speaker1: Honestly, most guys are better off not getting married; unless a girl’s really into him, it’s basically a guarantee he’s just living as her slave.
Speaker2: For real, she's definitely just looking for a cash cow.

Speaker1: Wouldn't it have been better to just take the heat and show something more with the national team?
Speaker2: Is it really normal to pick a kid who bullied others to represent our country? For real, lol?
Speaker1: Then go ahead and whine about getting wrecked by Japan after canceling our top squad, lol.
Speaker2: Wow, defending bullying is wild lol. You’re just gonna back that up when we’re gonna get wrecked anyway?

Speaker1: Aren't people just dumb for falling for jeonse scams? Like, why brag about that?
Speaker2: If things go south, it can happen in a blink. When they’re set on scamming, you’ll get got.
Speaker1: It's all self-inflicted. Just drifting through life leads to stuff like this.

Speaker1: Some customer was like, "With no customers like this, you're gonna go under soon."
Speaker2: Sounds like they're just talking trash.
Speaker1: That really hurt, and I’ve got a tough mindset.
Speaker2: Hope you hit it big and seal that mouth up with cement.
Speaker1: Ugh, opened with hundreds of millions spent, and my rent and management fees are ten million a month, but today’s sales are only twenty thousand.
Speaker2: For real, the economy's wrecked. Our neighborhood shops are totally empty.

Speaker1: No reason for them to meet there unless it's for sponsorship.
Speaker2: But they’re just not saying anything 'cause they might get sued.
Speaker1: Lmao, a forty-something lady running around trying to use her body to get by like Ok-soon.
Speaker2: It's just that they're pretending they ran into each other by chance in the U.S. or whatever...

Speaker1: I got hooked and binge-watched Chinese dramas all night.
Speaker2: I wanna watch it too, but my sister's being a pain about it.
Speaker1: What, did you get your iPad taken?
Speaker2: Yeah, so I just crashed after tossing and turning all night.

Speaker1: I heard there's someone who held their right arm up for 47 years for a spiritual practice.
Speaker2: That’s just from a disease, but if they say it’s from religious practice, it gets attention and makes money, so I guess that’s the deal.
Speaker1: Isn't that just a mental breakdown? I don't get how holding up your arm relates to spiritual practice or world peace.
Speaker2: At least if you’re holding your hand up forever, you won’t get in a car accident, lol.

Speaker1: What are they even thinking, like they think contracts are a joke or something?
Speaker2: For real, they should've had them study a bit too, not just dance and sing.
Speaker1: Well, they’re done for now. Better figure out how to make a living.
Speaker2: For real, Korea's not an easy place for dropouts or low grads, lol.

Speaker1: In Daegu, that's just the default, I guess.
Speaker2: Whoa, that's some serious pressure. Guess that "Gyeongsangdo barley" saying isn't just for show.
Speaker1: But the portion was only about 2 servings, you know? Still tasted good, though.
Speaker2: At least that's a relief.
Speaker1: The joy of traveling is the good food, but when that happens, it totally kills the vibe.

Speaker1: I’m hyped because the coin I’ve been mining is listing today.
Speaker2: Did you see the news? The supply is insane. It's gonna tank, right?
Speaker1: A penny's still free money, right?
Speaker2: Ain't no trades if no one's buying, right? Feels like it's just sellers out there.
Speaker1: It's all just a wash anyway. Some people buy in the early listings. As long as the last bomb isn't in my hands, I'm good lol.
Speaker2: What are you even expecting when they’ve already milked it overseas and are just dumping it on Korea as a last cleanup?

Speaker1: Sometimes the other person gets mad at stuff I say without thinking in messages.
Speaker2: Yikes, thought I was being sarcastic when I used a tilde (~). What a twisted mindset, right?
Speaker1: Yeah, I used "o o" and someone got all worked up about it.
Speaker2: For real, I kinda think that too. Like, do they even care to use vowels?
Speaker1: That could be a thing, I guess.

Speaker1: Seriously?
Speaker2: Huh? What part's harassment?
Speaker1: I explained it wasn’t meant that way, but they were dead serious about wanting an apology instead of excuses.
Speaker2: What’s your reasoning for saying that?
Speaker1: I was just joking around to cheer her on. I had no intention of being creepy at all.
Speaker2: Guess we just gotta stick to work talk at the office now. All that buddy-buddy stuff is old news.

Speaker1: So basically, they're saying don't work if you have kids in 1st or 2nd grade?
Speaker2: Is the shortened work schedule even useful?
Speaker1: I seriously don’t get what they’re thinking.
Speaker2: Sounds like it’s just for the kids in the 늘봄 class, not all of them.
Speaker1: What are single-parent families supposed to do? I get it’s all just red tape, but come on.

Speaker1: Yeah, all those construction sites are just temp workers, so the company’s gonna bail and act like it’s not their problem, lol.
Speaker2: If you're suing the construction company, you gotta dig up the operator's personal info yourself.
Speaker1: Construction companies just wanna dodge paying up.
Speaker2: They're just having a public trial over nothing without even reading a line of the indictment from a case that hasn't even been decided by the court.

Speaker1: Gotta sue for that, no way it makes sense not to, especially after profiting off it.
Speaker2: What were they thinking, registering that so boldly after making money off defamation?
Speaker1: Clearly, they barely graduated elementary school with some backdoor cash.
Speaker2: Anyway, I really hope they get hit hard with no leniency.
Speaker1: All the hate comments are bad enough, but now they're using all sorts of creative ways to torture people—just lock them all up...

Speaker1: Isn't that a patient, not a doctor? They just talk trash all the time.
Speaker2: Seriously, you picked someone like that to represent you? Acting all smart and whatnot…
Speaker1: So if we trash talk them, it's just free speech? No one's suing for defamation?
Speaker2: That person’s a pediatrician? Yikes, they’re gonna mess up the kids.

Speaker1: Heard there's a lot of scams going on with secondhand deals lately.
Speaker2: Can’t buy anything used, those jerks lol.
Speaker1: They're redirecting me to links when I'm paying with my own money, can you believe that?
Speaker2: If you fall for that kind of crap, you probably ain't smart enough for any deal, so best to skip secondhand stuff altogether.

Speaker1: What, you think they just ran away or something? Neither side's reps showed up.
Speaker2: They probably wouldn’t get it, just a bunch of jobless folks clicking likes and dislikes all day.
Speaker1: They usually just send reps to civil cases, but the headline's a bit misleading.
Speaker2: They’re commenting without even knowing what a legal representative is, like their brains are stuck in kindergarten...

Speaker1: Is it right to just dismiss someone as old without knowing what values or life goals they’ve had? I’m not even an aunt at 92.
Speaker2: Haha, if you were born in '92, you're basically an aunt now. Even younger soldiers get called uncle, lol. Guess you’re kinda lagging behind.
Speaker1: Why are you being so narrow-minded? They could've had a tough life or a painful love story.
Speaker2: Why should I understand and take responsibility for a woman who's been through a bunch of guys and has a worn-out body and mind?

Speaker1: A 59-year-old newbie quit after just three days.
Speaker2: If it feels off, better to bail fast; it helps both sides.
Speaker1: It's making me doubt the work ethic of older folks since a guy in his early 50s quit after just 10 days.
Speaker2: Getting older means being quick on the uptake. They’re quick to bounce too.
Speaker1: Should I be thankful they left on good terms? Not hiring old folks again.

Speaker1: Quit with the nonsense, that’s just ridiculous lol.
Speaker2: Not made up. This really happened in the U.S.
Speaker1: You’re talking a lot of nonsense without even checking it out, huh? lol.
Speaker2: Are you the one with reading comprehension issues?

Speaker1: Got caught trash-talking my boss anonymously on the company board, and now my info's all out there.
Speaker2: So I don’t even go near the bulletin board. Don’t wanna see that kind of drama.
Speaker1: Yikes, what’s with all the drama over just venting?
Speaker2: Best to just avoid those with reading comprehension issues.
Speaker1: Just gotta think we're all in the same boat and let it go.
Speaker2: It's a company for making money, not for making friends. Just sayin'.

Speaker1: I think it’s best to move out as soon as possible.
Speaker2: You gotta watch your back just to grab a chicken.

Speaker1: I don't think it's just this one accident that's bringing up divorce... feels like there's a lot built up.
Speaker2: Isn't the fact that this incident sparked divorce talks a sign of how much little stuff has built up over time?
Speaker1: Couples are supposed to walk hand in hand, but if that fragile trust breaks, they can't stay together.
Speaker2: Isn't it common sense to talk things out when there are issues in a relationship instead of bottling it up and blowing up later?

Speaker1: My middle schooler’s room had cigarettes again. I’m shaking all over.
Speaker2: Again? Cut off her allowance. She's buying them with the money she has.
Speaker1: So disappointing, especially after she wrote a letter saying she wouldn't do it again.
Speaker2: Heard it’s harder for girls to quit. They get more dependent.
Speaker1: It’s gross, my kid smells like smoke.
Speaker2: You gotta be firm about this. Handle it decisively.

Speaker1: Yikes, seeing people in miniskirts in winter makes me think they’re crazy.
Speaker2: You just don’t get the basics of being stylish, huh? Gotta sweat in summer and freeze in winter.
Speaker1: Gotta look good even if it means freezing to death, my mom says.
Speaker2: Long live fleece-lined tights!

Speaker1: Did you see that car going the wrong way in the three-lane?
Speaker2: Haha, right? Driving like that and then getting mad? What a joke.
Speaker1: I’m scared to think where and how they learned to drive like that.
Speaker2: They didn’t learn anything, just got a screw loose. The only real cure is the death penalty, or they just need to crash somewhere and let nature take its course.

Speaker1: I really get that parents would give their lives for their kids.
Speaker2: That's kinda cringey, honestly.
Speaker1: Isn't raising a kid like you without ditching them true maternal and paternal love?
Speaker2: Still better than you, though. Shoutout to your parents for knowing you weren't human and ditching you early.

Speaker1: They say small business owners are really struggling these days.
Speaker2: They’re acting like they’re dying 'cause business is slow.
Speaker1: But the funny thing is, these days it's hard to even book a spot, the parking's full, and finding a designated driver ain't easy.
Speaker2: What’s the deal? The economic indicators say the economy’s in the dumps.
Speaker1: Is it just crowded in some places? Anyway, it’s weird.

Speaker1: Haha, the media's all doom and gloom, but actual stats show spending's going crazy.
Speaker2: The top 30% are doing fine, but the rest are really struggling.
Speaker1: The bottom tier feels it more when the top 30% keeps bragging about their trips abroad.
Speaker2: Are you really that clueless about the overall stats and income/consumption divide?

Speaker1: I thought I'd get married quick 'cause I'm pretty and well-endowed.
Speaker2: Haha, your looks can't cover up that personality issue, you know? You got no self-awareness? lol
Speaker1: Rich guys should be lining up for me. I'm definitely marrying a wealthy dude.
Speaker2: Is there really gonna be a guy out there who can satisfy your money-loving greed?

Speaker1: I'm about to lose it over this employee who just makes excuses and talks back all the time.
Speaker2: Just fire them. Why are you keeping them around?
Speaker1: I gotta have the power to fire them, you know.

Speaker1: It's not being sensitive; they're just a clueless idiot who can't learn.
Speaker2: Seriously hard to work with.
Speaker1: I’ve worked with a crazy person like that too.
Speaker2: The worst is when they’re a total jerk but still get recognized for doing good work.

Speaker1: I'm so over my parents fighting about money all the time.
Speaker2: Just because you’re older doesn’t mean you’re an adult.
Speaker1: It drives me crazy when I have to beg for a few bucks.
Speaker2: Worst parents ever. Can't even help out.
